metadata.title: Ships of the ancient seas
metadata.selection: Partial archaeological coverage plus curated Viking/ancient highlights. Not a complete European inventory.
metadata.emodnetCredit: This data was downloaded from the EMODnet Portal (https://emodnet.ec.europa.eu/en/). The data originator is AND-International.
metadata.emodnetOriginalProvider: University of Oxford – The Oxford Roman Economy Project; Strauss, J. (2013), Shipwrecks Database, version 1.0.
metadata.dateConvention: Negative years are BCE; positive years are CE; no year zero. Whole-century bins are broad filter envelopes, not confidence intervals. Circa dates filter by their nominal year without invented uncertainty intervals.
metadata.locationConvention: Rounded to two decimal places for regional display; precision is not accuracy. Displaced numbered badges have leaders to the reported point.
cautions: Museums are not original find sites.
Periods and associations are not proven crew nationalities.
Site/group records are not counts of individual ships.
